conviction_note: There is no earnings event on 2026-08-31: CBAK completed its redomicile to the Cayman Islands on 2026-06-23 and, as a foreign private issuer, is expressly exempt from filing Form 10-Q and Form 8-K, so Q2 2026 is the first quarter it has no obligation or practice of reporting — and the company, which has always pre-announced its print by press release roughly a week ahead, has issued five releases since 2026-07-14 and scheduled nothing.

findings.finding: CBAK's own proxy for the redomicile states the successor Cayman entity will be 'exempt from filing quarterly reports on Form 10-Q under the Exchange Act with the SEC' and also exempt from Form 8-K, and the redomicile became effective 2026-06-23 — meaning Q2 2026, the quarter the 2026-08-31 calendar row refers to, is the first quarter for which no quarterly report is due at all.
findings.why_not_priced: This is not a price finding, it is an event finding: the calendar row exists only because aggregators extrapolated the pre-redomicile 10-Q cadence (Q2 2025 reported in August 2025) forward. If the change of reporting regime had been absorbed, the aggregators would agree on a date; instead TipRanks flagged 'CBAT Earnings this Week' for the week of 2026-08-17, Nasdaq shows 2026-08-31 with no session time, and stockanalysis.com shows 2026-09-01 — three different projected dates and no company confirmation behind any of them.
findings.independence: The redomicile completion release confirms the 2026-06-23 effective date and successor-issuer status under Rule 12g-3: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/23/3316412/0/en/CBAK-Energy-Completes-Redomiciliation-to-the-Cayman-Islands.html

findings.finding: CBAK invariably pre-announces its results date by press release with about six days' notice (e.g. 2026-03-24 release for the 2026-03-30 FY2025 print, 2023-08-02 release for the 2023-08-09 Q2 print), yet its IR newsroom shows releases on 2026-07-14, 08-10, 08-13, 08-20 and 08-25 with no results-date announcement, and its events page lists no earnings call for 31 August or 1 September.
findings.why_not_priced: A confirmed print two sessions away would show a 'CBAK Energy to Report...' release dated roughly 2026-08-24 sitting between the 08-20 capacity release and the 08-25 order release; there is none. The last actual print was Q1 2026 on 2026-05-18, and the CFO's 2026-08-27 investor-conference deck still cited Q1 2026 revenue of $69.62m as the company's latest reported financials — behaviour inconsistent with a company two business days from releasing H1 numbers.
findings.independence: The events/webcast page independently lists no scheduled earnings call: https://ir.cbak.com.cn/Webcast_Presentations.html ; and the 2026-08-27 conference write-up shows Q1 2026 as the latest disclosed financials: https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/cbak-energy-at-clean-energy-metals-conference-growth-meets-discount-93CH-4879738

findings.finding: The baseline's own EDGAR pull found zero 8-K item 2.02 filings under the new CIK 0002086841, which is exactly what the FPI exemption from Form 8-K predicts — the earnings-release filing channel the aggregators' cadence was built on no longer exists for this issuer.
findings.why_not_priced: The aggregator date survives because nobody re-derives cadence after a change of issuer entity; the StockTitan feed for CBAT for July and August 2026 carries four operational press releases and no 6-K, 20-F or results filing, so there is no filed document anywhere pointing at 31 August.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR submissions API and browse-edgar for CIK 0002086841 and 0001117171 — both returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so the filing list could not be read directly; relied on the baseline's own EDGAR pull plus press-release feeds instead
EDGAR full-text search for any 6-K or H1 2026 results filing by CBAK Cayman — endpoint 403
Searched for a 'CBAK Energy to Report Second Quarter and First Half 2026' announcement in any form — none exists in GlobeNewswire, Manila Times syndication, StockTitan or the company IR newsroom
Checked whether the 2026-08-17 date projected by TipRanks produced a print — it did not; the date passed with only operational releases

Nasdaq minimum-bid-price angle: notice received 2026-04-30, compliance deadline 2026-10-27, no reverse-split proposal or compliance plan disclosed — real but not an earnings catalyst and not dated to 31 August

Did not pursue fundamentals (India $96m order 2026-08-25, Nanjing 32140 capacity, AI data-centre backup power) because with no event there is nothing to trade them into; the +86% 20-day run-up is plainly the market already absorbing those releases
baseline_tension: The baseline could not classify event plausibility because the new CIK has no filing history to infer a cadence from — that absence is itself the answer, and the +86% 20-day run-up is explained entirely by the 13/20/25 August operational and order releases rather than by positioning into a print that was never scheduled.
